## Android and iOS (Platform; G-cluster cloud apps)

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.sqex.game.ff13_3 -- the Android row -- accessed 2026-10-20; last capture 2024-09-02: https://web.archive.org/web/20240902075537/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.sqex.game.ff13_3
- The iOS row links the official G-cluster game page, capture of 2025-01-14 (no App Store id found): https://web.archive.org/web/20250114090019/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/lrff13/index.html -- same notice and supported OS list as the XIII-2 page
  - Cloud-streaming apps by Broadmedia's G-cluster (Japan only): new sales stopped 2024-08-30 noon, service for buyers until 2025-02-28 noon (the Play page notice, https://gcluster.jp/news/20240808.html); the store pages are gone (404), so the rows are struck and link the last captures
  - The same notice's apps run on the G-cluster cloud, so the rows say `G-cluster cloud`
- https://web.archive.org/web/20161229063206/https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B01E5IWNSO -- the Amazon Appstore (Japan) row's app, Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII, by Broadmedia GC, ASIN B01E5IWNSO, first listed 2016-04-27, version 1.4.1 of 2016-12-23, support language Japanese, Fire tablets and Fire TV (a review says a PS4 pad on Fire TV did not work); the developer link on the page is http://gcluster.jp/sp/app/sqex/lrff13/ (the Broadmedia publisher link has no Wayback capture) -- user, 2026-10-22; capture of 2016-12-29 renders
- The Apple TV row links the pages below -- accessed 2026-10-22
  - https://web.archive.org/web/20161229063206/https://web.archive.org/web/20250114090019/https://gcluster.jp/pc/app/sqex/lrff13/index.html -- the official page linked from this entry on the list -- accessed 2026-10-25 -- shallow: not read (link taken from the list)
  - Broadmedia's App Store developer page (https://web.archive.org/web/20191231113138/https://apps.apple.com/jp/developer/broadmedia-gc-corporation/id1144024684, user 2026-10-22) lists Lightning Returns (id 1080609940) under both iPhone/iPad and Apple TV; the same app
  - Uptodown (https://xiii.jp.uptodown.com/android, text pasted by user 2026-10-20): Lightning Returns Final Fantasy XIII, version 1.10.200 dated 2024-10-08, developer Broadmedia G-cluster, a cloud game with a 30-minute free trial (progress is not saved during the trial) and Android 6.0 or later; package jp.co.sqex.game.ff13_3
  - Dive In: a PC Lightning Returns was planned but never made available (the Final Fantasy Wiki's Dive In page)

## G-cluster (Platform; G-cluster cloud TV version)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20250114090031/https://gcluster.jp/pc/games/lrff13.html -- the `g-cluster-tv` row's link, G-cluster's TV game page (last capture, 2025-01-14, renders) -- accessed 2026-10-22
  - First capture https://web.archive.org/web/20160125071127/https://gcluster.jp/pc/games/lrff13.html (2016-01-25); start 2016-01-21
  - The original story with no changes, part of the downloadable content bundled, no Dolby Digital; fits the 2015 Windows Remaster, the page does not say Windows
  - The TV version; the page's device logos: Android TV, G-cluster, Sharp, Bravia, LG; no stop-of-sale notice on the 2025-01-14 page
  - Also on Sharp's own COCORO GAME service, which ended 2021-05-31 (notice: https://cocoroplus.jp.sharp/news/7280/); its game list (first capture https://web.archive.org/web/20190724070019/https://cocoroplus.jp.sharp/game/list/, with all seven FF titles and no links; the last capture, 2026-02-13, is stale) -- user, 2026-10-22; not part of the G-cluster TV row, whose service ended 2025-02-28
  - Japan only; the whole G-cluster service ended 2025-02-28 noon, per the notice in sources/final-fantasy-franchise.md, so the row is struck

## Hikari TV Games (Platform; Hikari TV cloud, set-top box)

- https://web.archive.org/web/20220616233445/http://game.hikaritv.net/title/lrff13/index.html -- the `hikari-tv-games` row's link, the service's own game page; start 2016-02-08 (the service's news list) -- user, 2026-10-22; accessed 2026-10-22
  - The original story with no changes and part of the downloadable content bundled, no Dolby Digital, no achievement rewards; copyright 2013 and 2015; rated 15+ (the page header shows XIII-2 by mistake)
  - Played with a game pad on a Hikari TV set-top box (NTT Plala, later Docomo), sold as a single title, not in the play-all pack; Japan only
  - The service ended 2023-09-30 23:59 (see sources/final-fantasy-franchise.md), so the row is struck; the row sits on the Remaster 2015 version, the same one as the G-cluster row
  - Phone or tablet use is not recorded either way: the site never marked which titles ran on its Android app (2013-11-20 to 2016-08-31, no iOS app; the service said only some titles did), so there is no phone row; one needs a source that names this title on the app. Unresolved lead: the service's news items of 2014-03-04 (the phone titles changed) and 2016-08-01 (the end of the phone and tablet app), if either lists titles (user, 2026-10-22)

## Cloud service launches (Platform; G-cluster)

- TV (G-cluster console and G-cluster TVs, Sharp and LG): 2016-01-21; the release states the story is the original's, unchanged, and that Hikari TV Games would follow in sequence (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2016/01/21-001393.html)
- Phone app: 2016-02-17 on Google Play (jp.co.sqex.game.ff13_3) and the App Store (id1080609940, the same listing as the Apple TV app) (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2016/02/17-001397.html)
- Apple TV: 2016-08-04 (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/20160804_001_J.pdf)
- Amazon Android app store: 2016-04-27, one of five apps released together (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/dock/20160428-001_01.pdf)
